description:
From the moment Dohyun stepped into his lonely world, Jaewon has been pining for him for six years.He even followed him all the way to the same university.Full of anticipation, Jaewon went to Dohyun’s place—only to walk in on a half-naked Dohyun and his girlfriend.Still, he thought that once they were home, things could go back to the way they used to be…While Jaewon does everything he can to force his way into Dohyun’s daily life, Dohyun is busy pushing him away.“I told you I like you, hyung.”“You were just lonely back then. I just happened to be there.”Six years of unwavering feelings are dismissed as mere loneliness, and every attempt to get closer is rejected.Will the two of them be able to keep living together without everything falling apart?

[Original Webtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/nyang_taek)
